# **Lob Subprocessors**

Last Updated: May 4, 2026

To provide our Services, Lob.com, Inc. (“Lob”) uses third-party service providers that have access to Customer Data (each, a “Subprocessor”). The Subprocessor List below provides important information about the identity, role, and location of each Subprocessor.

The Subprocessor(s) we use may change from time to time. Please review this page regularly and/or sign up below to stay informed about updates to this Subprocessor List.

All capitalized terms not defined on this page shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Terms of Service located at [www.lob.com/terms](https://www.lob.com/terms) or, if applicable, the separate written services agreement governing the relationship between Lob and the Customer.
